name: tellagen
description: Tellagen incident investigation plugin: sign in with your browser, diagnose incidents with your own tools, post findings and figures, and keep a record of the steps.

record_steps.title: Record steps of a diagnosis
record_steps.description: While a Tellagen diagnosis run is open, record each Grafana and GitHub read and each kubectl and gh command as a step of the run. It sends the tool, the query or command (tokens and passwords masked), a short summary and the size of the result; never the whole result. Turn it off to post steps by hand.
